task: In Production only, change the traffic split of the multivariate flag "live_chat_copy" so the "Try it free" variation gets 70% of users and the rest stay on the control value. Development keeps its current split.
finalText:
DONE: Production's `live_chat_copy` now gives "Try it free" 70% of users, with the remaining 30% on the control value "Start free trial"; Development is still at 50%.

One side effect to know about: my first attempt used `feature variant update`, which changed the shared feature-level variant weight to 70 for a moment. I reverted it to 50 straight away, and the shared definition is back to its original state. The final change was made with `flag update --weight b=70` in Production only.
commands: flagsmith flags list --help 2>&1 | head -40; echo ---; flagsmith --help 2>&1 | grep -i -A2 "environ\|segment"
flagsmith feature --help; echo ---; flagsmith feature update --help 2>&1; echo ---; flagsmith flag --help
flagsmith feature variant --help; echo ---; flagsmith feature variant update --help 2>&1; echo ---; flagsmith feature get live_chat_copy 2>&1; echo ---; flagsmith environment list 2>&1
for e in [env-c8d6c477bbda8aab] [env-723a87db63acc4a2]; do echo "== $e"; flagsmith -e $e flag get live_chat_copy 2>&1; flagsmith -e $e feature variant list live_chat_copy 2>&1; done

flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag get live_chat_copy --json 2>&1 | jq . | head -80; flagsmith -e [env-c8d6c477bbda8aab] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '.multivariate_options // .variants // .'

flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] feature variant update live_chat_copy 87 --weight 70 2>&1; echo "--- verify PROD"; flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '.variants'; echo "--- verify DEV"; flagsmith -e [env-c8d6c477bbda8aab] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '.variants'

flagsmith feature variant list live_chat_copy --json 2>&1 | jq -c .; flagsmith feature get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c .; flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c .variants

flagsmith api --help 2>&1 | head -30; echo ---; flagsmith feature variant update --help >/dev/null; flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag get live_chat_copy --json >/dev/null; flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag update --help 2>&1 | head -30

flagsmith feature variant update live_chat_copy 87 --weight 50 2>&1; flagsmith feature variant list live_chat_copy --json | jq -c .; for e in [env-c8d6c477bbda8aab] [env-723a87db63acc4a2]; do flagsmith -e $e flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '.variants'; done

flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag update live_chat_copy --weight b=70 2>&1; echo "--- PROD"; flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '{value,enabled,variants}'; echo "--- DEV"; flagsmith -e [env-c8d6c477bbda8aab] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '{value,enabled,variants}'; echo "--- feature-level"; flagsmith feature variant list live_chat_copy --json | jq -c .

flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag update live_chat_copy --weight b=70 --yes 2>&1 | head -5; echo "--- PROD"; flagsmith -e [env-723a87db63acc4a2] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '{value,enabled,variants}'; echo "--- DEV"; flagsmith -e [env-c8d6c477bbda8aab] flag get live_chat_copy --json | jq -c '{value,enabled,variants}'; echo "--- feature-level"; flagsmith feature variant list live_chat_copy --json | jq -c .
